title: Your First Weekend at California State University-San Marcos, Shared as Cards
description: A Friday-to-Sunday sequence mixing recognizable campus landmarks, social spaces, recreation, food, nearby trails, and a practical library reset.

cards.title: Start with Tukwut
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Craven Hall courtyard
cards.notes: Find the bronze cougar in Craven Hall’s third-floor courtyard and use this distinctive campus landmark as your weekend starting point.
cards.short_summary: Meet the campus mascot in bronze before learning the surrounding paths.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM identifies “Tukwut” as a life-size bronze cougar sculpture in the third-floor courtyard of Craven Hall and explains that its name is Luiseño for mountain lion.
cards.source_title: Remembering Artist Who Created Tukwut Sculpture
cards.access_notes: Located in Craven Hall’s third-floor courtyard; building access and operating times should be checked before visiting.

cards.title: Learn the Rotunda Landmark
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Craven Hall
cards.notes: Step beneath the rotunda, then note its shape from nearby paths so you can use Craven Hall as a visual wayfinding reference.
cards.short_summary: Turn a prominent piece of campus architecture into an easy navigation cue.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM describes Craven Hall as a prominent campus building flanked by an iconic rotunda that appears in the university’s logo.
cards.source_title: Icons of CSUSM: The Stories Behind Building Names
cards.access_notes: View the rotunda from publicly accessible campus paths; verify building access before entering.

cards.title: Explore the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Center of campus
cards.notes: Walk through the USU, locate the amphitheater and rooftop garden, and identify a comfortable place to regroup between weekend plans.
cards.short_summary: Survey the central student-life building and its indoor-outdoor gathering areas.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM states that the University Student Union sits between Kellogg Library and Chavez Plaza and includes an amphitheater, activity center, game lounge, rooftop garden, patio, and ballroom.
cards.source_title: The New Heart of CSUSM, USU Opens Its Doors
cards.access_notes: Amenities may follow separate schedules or require student identification; confirm current USU access on arrival.

cards.title: Share a First Dinner
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · The QUAD
cards.notes: Check the live dining schedule, then meet at the café’s indoor or outdoor seating; bring a payment method or eligible meal-plan access.
cards.short_summary: Use the residential dining hall as a simple first-night meeting point.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM reports that Campus Way Café occupies the ground floor of The QUAD, provides indoor and outdoor seating, and is open to students, employees, guests, and the San Marcos community.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Cafe on Track for August Grand Opening
cards.access_notes: Check the current CSUSM dining schedule before going; service hours vary by academic calendar and break period.

cards.title: Walk the Lake Loop
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Lakeview Park
cards.notes: Meet at Lakeview Park and follow the established one-mile route around Discovery Lake; carry water and remain on marked public trails.
cards.short_summary: Begin Saturday outdoors with a manageable local nature walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of San Marcos documents a one-mile interpretive nature walk around Discovery Lake beginning from Lakeview Park at 650 Foxhall Drive.
cards.source_title: Discover the Great Outdoors with San Marcos at Trails Day
cards.access_notes: Use marked park trails and check city notices for closures, construction, weather hazards, or restoration work.

cards.title: Find the Athletics Landmark
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Campus athletics area
cards.notes: Locate Mangrum Track & Field from the official map and view it from an authorized public area; do not enter during restricted use.
cards.short_summary: Connect the campus map to a named venue with deep ties to Cougar athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM identifies Mangrum Track & Field on its campus map and states that the venue opened in 1999 and hosts athletics events and commencement ceremonies.
cards.source_title: Icons of CSUSM: The Stories Behind Building Names
cards.access_notes: Athletic surfaces may be restricted for practices, competitions, or events; observe posted access rules.

cards.title: Try an Indoor Climb
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · North City
cards.notes: Review admission, waiver, orientation, and age requirements before leaving campus; choose an introductory option suited to your experience.
cards.short_summary: Add an active indoor outing at a named climbing gym near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Mesa Rim’s official location page identifies its North City climbing facility at 285 Industrial Street in San Marcos and publishes weekend operating hours.
cards.source_title: Location + Hours | Mesa Rim North City
cards.access_notes: Officially listed Saturday and Sunday hours are 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; verify current hours, waiver rules, and minor supervision requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Close Saturday at Double Peak
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · 900 Double Peak Drive
cards.notes: Arrive with daylight, use the telescope or picnic area, and leave according to posted park rules rather than attempting an unmarked route.
cards.short_summary: End the day at a city park with a viewpoint, telescope, and trail connection.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of San Marcos lists Double Peak Park at 900 Double Peak Drive with a telescope, amphitheater, picnic facilities, restrooms, play equipment, and a trail connection.
cards.access_notes: Check posted park hours and current trail conditions; arrive before dark and remain in designated public areas.

cards.title: Set Up Sunday at Kellogg
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Campus
cards.notes: Use the Sunday window to locate checkout services, study spaces, and research help before the academic week begins.
cards.short_summary: Turn a library visit into a practical rehearsal for the first week of classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The CSUSM University Library publishes Kellogg Library building hours, including Sunday hours of noon–8 p.m. for its spring 2026 schedule.
cards.source_title: Library Hours and Events | CSUSM University Library
cards.access_notes: The published spring 2026 Sunday schedule is noon–8 p.m.; summer weekends are closed, so confirm the active term calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Bookmark a Creative Return
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Kellogg Library second floor
cards.notes: Locate The Makery while visiting Kellogg, review its activities, and save a weekday return time if the makerspace is closed on Sunday.
cards.short_summary: Finish by finding a hands-on campus resource for a later creative break.
cards.evidence_claim: The CSUSM Library identifies The Makery as a second-floor makerspace where community members can create, socialize, play games, and try short activities such as coloring and making pinback buttons.
cards.access_notes: The published 2026 schedules show The Makery closed on weekends; use this stop to locate it and confirm a later open session.
